activation_baseline.basis: The immutable v676-v7 repository seal, the post-canonical and route-retry overlays, and seven retained remaster-startup failure/recovery pairs.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: An initial skill-inventory PowerShell pipeline hit the empty-pipe parser fault before producing a complete inventory.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The values were materialized before projection and all explicitly named skills were then read completely.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A broad recursive phase-file display exceeded the model-visible output context and was truncated.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Bounded exact-pattern inventory and per-file size probes replaced the broad display without repeating it.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A combined authorization-state display exceeded its visible envelope before the full state was read.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Nonoverlapping bounded line windows completed the authorization and schema read through EOF.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first meta-tool reference probe guessed JSON extensions for Markdown reference files and found no targets.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: An exact bounded reference inventory recovered the real Markdown filenames, which were then read through EOF.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A combined multi-registry metadata projection completed without attributable output inside its response contract.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Independent bounded PyPI, npm, PowerShell Gallery, and Codex version probes recovered exact current candidate versions.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A broad Git-grep proposal-title projection completed without attributable output inside its response contract.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The remaster uses one exact Git-object semantic audit with bounded output and preserves the failed grep attempt at zero credit.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first exact git add omitted sparse mode and Git refused the new owner-document paths outside the existing sparse definition.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The same exact owner allowlist is staged with git add --sparse; no sparse pattern, sibling path, or inherited byte is changed.
